product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT provides data extraction, migration, archiving and lifecycle management software that keeps patient, employee and business records accessible and secure for healthcare organizations.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes standard, enterprise and SaaS pricing models and pricing components; numeric prices are not published.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains healthcare IT advice, product information and company news, not an engineer-authored product-building blog meeting the two-post criterion.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation for the acquired Blue Elm product family includes OpenGate, DR Auditor, DR Dashboard and Conversions tutorials on Harmony’s own site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current board lists Data Conversion Interface Analyst, Systems Analyst, AWS DevOps Engineer and Associate Business Development Director; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No product model/provider disclosure found in ClearWay announcements, AI resources, product tutorials, security materials or privacy policy. The linked Trust Center did not expose a readable public subprocessor list. Website marketing vendors are not treated as product model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: Scope matters: the company claims SOC 2 Type II facilities, HIPAA compliance and GDPR compliance for EU/EEA residents—not that all three are corporate certifications. Its explicit corporate security certification is HITRUST, outside the five requested categories; no ISO 27001 or PCI DSS certification was established.

last_funding.notes: Novacap investment announced November 28, 2023. Amount not publicly disclosed in the cited sources, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest recorded financing is November 28, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. Acquisitions are not counted as funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The sales opening is Associate Business Development Director, not SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive under the requested title rule.

launched_6mo.notes: Latest explicit product-launch announcement located was ClearWay, February 25, 2025, outside May 9–November 9, 2026. June 2026 Keyword Search materials describe/promote a capability but do not identify it as newly launched; a dated promotional page alone was not counted as a launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Announced May 12, 2026: Brian Liddell became CEO effective April 30, 2026, succeeding Tom Liddell, who transitioned to Chairman.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting explicitly names Sugar CRM and Definitive Healthcare in the workflow. The privacy policy explicitly names the website marketing/tracking systems and states Act-On interfaces with its CRM. Salesforce appears only as preferred prior CRM experience, so is not asserted as deployed.
